  • GoWabiDescribe how Bella checks GoWabi purchases today

  • PaymentsChoose the payment provider and open a merchant account in Bella’s name
  • PaymentsApprove the deposit and refund policy
  • AnalyticsChoose an analytics tool together with Bella’s privacy reviewer
  • AnalyticsApprove the consent approach and the privacy-notice wording
  • SMS and email OTPChoose the SMS and email providers and sender names
  • SMS and email OTPApprove the OTP message wording in Thai, English and Chinese
  • Existing clinic softwareTell us whether Bella uses clinic, point-of-sale or booking software today, and who owns it
  • Social links (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok)Confirm the Facebook, Instagram and TikTok addresses (currently seen on public sources, not verified)

O2 (8)

  • LINE Messaging APIStore the channel secret in a secret manager and set its reference
  • LINE Messaging APISet the webhook on the verified production domain and validate the callback
  • LINE LoginRegister callback URLs on the verified domain
  • PaymentsStore the provider credentials in a secret manager
  • PaymentsSet the payment callback on the verified domain
  • AnalyticsDefine the event list with no personal or health information
  • Private file storageSet least-privilege credentials in a secret manager
  • SMS and email OTPStore the credentials in a secret manager

Bella and O2 (3)

  • LINE LoginCheck that Login and Messaging sit under one provider so identities match before the first link
  • Private file storageCreate a private S3-compatible bucket in an account Bella owns
